list: The official 55 trophies, as published on PlayStation and listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (frozen 2026-11-18, re-verified 2026-11-20). Names, descriptions and grades are the official text; guides are written for this entry, in our own words, and cite their sources.

trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it pops on its own the moment you have earned the other 54 trophies. There is nothing extra to do for it, so treat the roadmap as the guide — finish the story, the side strands, the collectibles and the long grinds, then A Long Road (100% completion) is usually the last one before this. Published estimates put the whole run at around 200 hours, at a 4-out-of-10 difficulty, and a single playthrough is enough.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.name: EGamers.io — trophy list and hardest trophies

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end. It is the first story mission and cannot be missed — the trophy pops when the mission completes, and it is the earliest trophy most players will earn.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene, so keep playing into the next chapter if it does not appear at once. Because the game has no mission replay, keep a manual save from the start of each chapter — the game offers 15 manual save slots plus one autosave.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run, and most of the open-world list opens up once both characters are playable, so Chapter 2 is a good time to start the side activities that are already available.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. One thing worth doing while you are here: Yago's timed race in his street-racing strand carries an hourglass icon and counts toward the Strangers & Freaks trophy, so save first and race it the moment it appears rather than leaving it for later.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. The robbery tools arrive through optional and story missions in the middle of the game, so by the end of this chapter you should have access to the bank vaults, armored trucks and jewelry robberies the later trophies need.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. It is unmissable, but keep an untouched manual save from just before it: there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so a save from before the finale is your only way back if you want to replay it or mop up anything you left behind.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. It is unmissable, and it matters beyond itself: switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after this mission, which unlocks the partner trophies and most of the co-op free-roam goals.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist. It is a story mission, so it pops as you play through the story — no special preparation, just complete the heist.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play. It is a story mission and pops automatically when the mission completes.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners. It is a story mission and pops automatically when the mission completes.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown. It is a story mission at Vice City International Airport and pops automatically when the mission completes.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a story mission and pops automatically when the mission completes.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist only appears after the story, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — but work you do earlier still counts, so do not wait until the credits to start it. The thresholds are lenient in places: 300 stunts instead of the trophy's 250, 70 of the 80 challenges, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 illegal operations, and 200 of the 277 vehicle models. Both published guides rank this the hardest trophy and the bulk of the roughly 200-hour platinum run.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: EGamers.io — trophy list and hardest trophies

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count, and they add up naturally across a full playthrough. Keep going past 250 if you want the platinum: 100% completion needs 300 stunts, so the extra 50 are not wasted effort.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type once — nine types in all, according to PlayStation's progress counter. This is a sampler, not a grind: one fishing trip, one race, one arcade game, one round of bowling and so on, and it pops when the last type is tried. If it has not popped, check which activity types you have not touched yet rather than repeating one you already did.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across two shooting ranges. Gold on every challenge is the hard part — work through one range at a time, and replay any challenge that lands on silver or bronze until it is gold. Nothing here is missable, so you can return to the ranges at any point after the story.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — at least one win per location, not one win in total. Work through the locations one by one and tick them off as you go; the trophy pops when the last location has a win.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Variety is what counts — winning the same race twenty times does not work, so spread your wins across the race types and locations the game offers, including street races and the Top Fun drone races.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the activity types, so a win here also counts toward trying every activity for Master of None. If you lose, challenge him again — fishing challenges can be retried.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete any one of the four in-game arcade games. It does not matter which one you pick, so choose the game you find easiest and play it through to the end. One completion is enough, and it also counts as trying an activity type for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to its final mission. Andy's strand does not count toward the Strangers & Freaks trophy — it has its own trophy instead — so do not expect progress there. Everything outside the story stays available after the credits, including the side-story finales, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission. Side-story finales stay available after the credits, so work through Kenton's strand at your own pace — it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to its final mission. Like Andy's strand, Billy's does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — it has its own trophy. It stays available after the credits, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Only some optional questlines count: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands do not, because they have their own trophies, so check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. One that does count is Yago's timed race in Chapter 3 — it should be called Race Against Yago, carries an hourglass icon, and is worth saving before you race it.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to its final mission. Side-story finales stay available after the credits, so this cannot be missed — work through Randy's strand whenever it appears.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to its final mission. Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — it has its own trophy instead. It stays available after the credits, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — the only trophy the published guides flag as possibly missable. Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida (18 spots on PlayStation's counter). Spots show as purple icons when you are close, and each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. The one you can lose is Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1: after Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning — a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time — she heads out to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate, so follow her and accept the optional task. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and nobody has confirmed that the trophy strictly needs it, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: EGamers.io — trophy list and hardest trophies

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Complete Bret Vogel's hunting questline — it is Jason-only — and hunt the unique animal it sends you after, working through its target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which is what the hunt wants. The questline stays available after the story, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are a collectible hunt across Leonida: gather the cards, finish three full sets, and the trophy pops. Keep your spares — a set only counts when it is complete.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations across Leonida. WAiNK is the in-game discovery app — the same one that counts as discovering a vehicle when you scan traffic — so make a habit of opening it and scanning at new places as you travel, and the count climbs on its own.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress, then Challenges, and many complete on their own while you play. The trophy needs 50, but 100% completion needs 70 of the 80, so keep going past the trophy if you are chasing the platinum.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, and escape the heat. The easiest pairing is a bank vault robbery: vault jobs give you a 4-star wanted level straight away, so escaping one with your partner earns this at the same time as Maximum Withdrawal. Note that the trophy only pops once you have left the red heat zone — getting out of the flashing search area is not enough.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner in, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. The chain breaks if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, so move fast between shops and do not let the wanted level drop. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive and the count climbs without a separate grind. For the platinum, 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past 100.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus, the slow-motion aim you trigger by pressing L3 and R3 while aiming. Each fish you land adds about 10% to the Focus meter, so fish first to fill it. Then pick a group of gang enemies — the guards at an illegal operation work well — and use an assault rifle; Adrenaline extends Focus, which helps you reach five.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work, while planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Go up to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino military tank. Tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on Goose Key at the bottom of the Keys. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being seen. Yasmani's Chapter 3 job, Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. Vault jobs give you a 4-star wanted level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. For the platinum, the 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults, not just 5.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Like the bank vaults, this only pops once you have left the red heat zone after the robbery, so keep driving until you are fully clear before expecting it. Armored trucks appear on the roads once the robbery tools are unlocked in the middle of the game.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. This fills in as you travel for the story, the side strands and the collectibles — just make sure you visit the far corners of the map, including the Keys at the bottom, rather than staying in Vice City. The game tracks each area the first time you enter it.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Illegal operations are the gang-run spots you can hit across Leonida, and each gang needs one. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this pops along the way if you are chasing the platinum.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This is a small moment trophy, not a grind: head to a bar or spot on Ocean Beach with a view of the water and order a cocktail. It pops when the scene plays out.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the front. Pick a showroom, line the car up, and go through it; the trophy is about the exit, so commit to the smash rather than easing out.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — finish a game there. Bowling is one of the activity types, so a game here also counts toward trying every activity for Master of None.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Get Jason and Lucia both to maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you — that is the point of the trophy, a partnership built at the gym. It should pop when both characters hit maximum Strength.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind — just play the game the way the other trophies ask you to, and the counter climbs. There is no single action to repeat; it is the running total of choices across the whole run.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — fail at something, then pull it off the next time. This is a hidden trophy with a deliberately vague description, so the honest guide is: keep playing, and when you fail a mission, challenge or activity, retry it at once rather than moving on. It pops on the successful retry.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange. This is a hidden trophy for a rare or odd in-game event, and its description gives nothing away. The published guides do not pin down a single trigger, so the honest guide is: keep an eye out for strange encounters while you explore Leonida — it is a moment trophy, not a grind, and it pops when the event happens to you.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — attack with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and bowl them over. Line up a slow pass, swing as you go by, and the trophy pops on the hit.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs, and you launder them by selling them to your contacts. The $250,000 total is cumulative across the whole run, so bank jobs and payday loan jobs both feed it — keep laundering as you go rather than saving it all for the end.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop, so normal play — weapons, clothes, food, car mods — adds up to it over a full run. If you are close at the end, a few big purchases in any shop will finish it.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count, so buy all eight from the app. Garages also matter for On the Spot, since each registered car needs a free garage space — buy garages first, then register cars.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes) and register cheap cars.
trophies.name: On the Spot
